recommendations: Ensure the torn edge clip-path is generated with enough segments to feel analog (30+ points).
Verify that the background motif doesn't interfere with body text contrast at various viewports.
evaluation.design_narrative: ManifestoCard demonstrates exceptional adherence to Kerala Rage principles. The use of Hero scale (144px) against standard body text creates high-tension contrast. The combination of Solidarity Red and Charcoal establishes a powerful Solidarity palette. Spring physics integration for the primary CTA is well-defined.
